_comment: Hard gates (minimums/maximums) are enforced by run_release_eval.py and run ONLY against metrics the eval actually computes. The deferred_* gates require producers that are not yet wired (LLM-judge faithfulness/correctness, prompt-injection probe, PII scan, multi-run stability) — see docs/audit. They are intentionally NOT enforced yet so the gate cannot become impossible-to-pass; wire their producers, then promote them into minimums/maximums.
